integrity: The proof is unrestricted and exhausts prime powers, squarefree semiprimes, squarefree three-prime products, and repeated-prime products \(p^2q\). The finite verifier is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only integers \(n>1\) with \(\Omega(n)\le3\). It does not classify higher multiplicity or establish infinitude of primes \(p\) for which \(p^2+p+1\) is prime.
title: Exact \(\Omega(n)\le3\) classification for \(n\mid\varphi(n)\sigma(n)\)
